Subject: Capacity top-up + invoice routing and PO attached

Hi Irene —

We're moving forward with the 150k token/month top-up we discussed in last week's renewal call. Procurement asked me to send the PO and clarify a couple billing items before you cut the invoice:

- PO attached (SkywardTech_PO_8321.pdf). It lists Skyward Technologies, Inc. as payor.
- We need invoices sent to AccountsPayable@skywardtech.com (AP contact is Accounts Payable).
- Our finance team prefers Net45 on renewals; is that possible for this amendment?
- They also need Redwood to confirm the legal entity and EIN you'll invoice under so our AP system can match the PO.

Attached a W9 as well — let me know if you need anything else to get the invoice out.

Thanks,
Elena Rivera
Director, Cloud Procurement
Skyward Technologies

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the PO and W9. Quick confirmation items so Finance can generate the amendment invoice correctly:

1) Redwood legal entity for invoicing is Redwood Inference, Inc. (EIN: 98-7654321).
2) We can accommodate Net45 for this amendment; I will flag the invoice terms accordingly.
3) One question from billing: do you want a single consolidated invoice for the whole commitment (Redwood sends one invoice for the top-up + base) or split by subscription line (commitment vs. top-up)? Splitting is common if your procurement needs separate PO numbers.

I'll loop in Billing (Ben) and Renewals (Jordan) to confirm the format and to prepare the amended contract for signature. If you'd like, we can send the Redwood amendment via DocuSign after we lock the invoice delivery details.

Next steps:
- Please confirm single vs. split invoice and the AP contact for the invoice metadata (name, email, phone).
- If Skyward requires any additional tax forms beyond the W9, let us know.

Best,

Irene / Jordan —

I've reviewed the PO and the W9. Recommendation from Billing: invoice under Redwood Inference, Inc. (EIN 98-7654321) with payment terms Net45 as requested. A few operational notes:

- Because the PO references a single entity (Skyward Technologies, Inc.) and only one PO number, we should issue a single consolidated invoice covering both the existing commitment and the 150k top-up. That will keep matching simple for their AP system.
- We'll include PO# 8321 in the invoice header and the amendment_reference RW-DEAL-3245.
- I'll prepare the invoice metadata to route to AccountsPayable@skywardtech.com and set the AP contact name to Elena Rivera in the invoice XML export.

Marissa, can you please draft the amendment (I attached a working doc) to reflect Net45 and the explicit invoice routing to AccountsPayable@skywardtech.com? Once Marissa posts the updated amendment, I'll queue it for DocuSign and cut the invoice on our next billing run.

Thanks,
